## Cloud Hosting {#cloud-hosting}

Enterprise-grade compute, storage, and networking with automated scaling, global CDN distribution, and infrastructure-as-code support for optimal performance.

- Auto-scaling compute and elastic block storage
- Global CDN and multi-region deployment
- Kubernetes-native container orchestration
- Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) support
- Transparent status monitoring and metered billing

[Discuss your hosting needs](contact.qmd){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

## Managed Services {#managed-services}

Full-stack management of your cloud environment — 24/7 monitoring, automated backups, security patching, and a dedicated support team.

- 24/7 monitoring and incident response
- Automated, regularly tested backups and disaster recovery
- Patch management and operating-system hardening
- Dedicated account manager and cloud architect
- ITIL-aligned service delivery and reporting

[Explore managed services](contact.qmd){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

## Security & Compliance {#security-compliance}

ISO 27001:2013 certified security with end-to-end encryption, managed DDoS protection, and the compliance frameworks regulated industries rely on.

- ISO 27001:2013, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 9001:2015
- End-to-end encryption and managed DDoS mitigation
- GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS compliance support
- Regular penetration testing and audit reporting
- Australian data sovereignty guarantee
